parsed_output.email_body:
Dear Cometeer Team,

I hope this email finds you well. Our team has been closely following Cometeer's innovative approach to coffee and its strong online presence on Instagram. We believe there is an opportunity to further engage your audience through a collaborative Instagram post series that highlights the behind-the-scenes journey of your coffee. This series would not only showcase the unique characteristics of each roast but also provide valuable information about your coffee-making process, addressing the identified gap of limited video content on Instagram.

We propose a series of videos that follow the journey from farm to cup, highlighting the unique characteristics of each roast. This would not only engage your audience but also demonstrate the quality and sustainability of your coffee. Let's work together to bring this idea to life!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
